# Marrakeche Crafts

> > Marrakeche Crafts preserves traditional Moroccan artisanal heritage by offering handmade home decor, furniture, and gifts directly from Berber craftspeople.

Marrakeche Crafts is an e-commerce platform dedicated to authentic Moroccan handcrafted goods, featuring fair-trade artisan products sourced directly from Morocco. The site emphasizes traditional craftsmanship, cultural preservation, and sustainable practices across home decor, furniture, textiles, and decorative accessories.

## Key Topics

- Moroccan handcrafted goods
- Berber artisans
- Fair-trade practices
- Leather poufs & ottomans
- Moroccan rugs
- Home decor
- Handwoven textiles
- Ceramic pottery
- Artisan furniture
- Traditional craftsmanship
- Boho interior design
- Kilim & Beni Ourain styles
- Decorative storage
- Wholesale options
- Sustainable sourcing

## Featured Collections

- [Handmade Home Decor & Gifts | Artisanal Accessories](https://www.marrakeche.com): Homepage showcasing Marrakeche's handmade Moroccan home decor and artisanal gifts.

- [About Marrakeche Crafts: Preserving Traditional Moroccan Art](https://www.marrakeche.com/about-us): Marrakeche Crafts' mission to empower Moroccan artisans and preserve traditional Berber heritage.

## Poufs & Ottomans

- [Leather Poufs & Ottomans | Handcrafted | 40+ Styles + Ship](https://www.marrakeche.com/leather-poufs): Genuine leather poufs in 40+ styles, handcrafted by artisans.

- [Round Leather Poufs | Handcrafted Ottomans | 25+ Colors](https://www.marrakeche.com/round-poufs): Handcrafted round leather poufs in 25+ colors by Moroccan artisans.
- [Straw Poufs | Handwoven Raffia Ottomans | Coastal Boho Style](https://www.marrakeche.com/straw-poufs): Lightweight handwoven straw poufs in natural raffia for boho coastal interiors.

## Textiles & Rugs

- [Moroccan Rugs Collection - Marrakeche Crafts](https://www.marrakeche.com/moroccan-rugs): Handwoven Berber rugs including Beni Ourain, Kilim, and Azilal styles.
- [Moroccan Pillow Covers Collection - Marrakeche Crafts](https://www.marrakeche.com/moroccan-pillow-covers): Handcrafted Moroccan pillow covers in cotton and silk with traditional embroidery.
